system.description:
You impart a scroll with your chakra seal, which conjures an immobile, cube shaped prison composed of chakra, which springs into existence, surrounding a point you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or box, choose one.

Cage. The Cage forms a prison with walls 20-feet long and 10 feet tall on each side, but the top and bottom of the prison is solid. The cage has bars with a 1-inch gap that allows vision within the prison.

Box. The box is a completely enclosed area with walls 10-feet long and 10 feet tall on each side, with no way to see inside. While inside creatures have total cover and cannot be harmed from outside effects.

Regardless of the shape of the prison, it has the same statistics;

Each wall has an AC of 10, 15 DR, and 120 Hit points.

Each wall has resistance to damage, unless it’s the result of a jutsu.

Creatures within the parameter of the prison cannot teleport without making a Charisma saving throw vs your Ninjutsu save DC.

This jutsu cannot be dispelled by effects, from effects of a rank lower than S-Rank.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, hit points by 20.
